logp.method_description: Lipophilicity of the ligands and complexes are determined by calculating logP values according to the shake-flask method [6]. Compounds under investigation are weighted out accurately and partitioned between equal volumes of water and 1-octanol (5 mL each) by shaking for 30 h at room temperature to assure full partitioning of the analyzed compounds between water and 1-octanol phases. Then, the solution is centrifuged at 3500 rpm for 10 min to separate into two layers. The concentration of the compounds in different layers is estimated by the optical density values obtained from UV–Vis spectroscopy. Concentration of organic, aqueous phase and logP values are in Table 1.
